Savant Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Savant Capital Llc bought 2,533 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 45,902 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.77 million, up from 43,369 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Savant Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $922.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.71% or $1.32 during the last trading session, reaching $187.63. About 16.71 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Gofen & Glossberg Llc increased its stake in Ford Motor (F) by 167.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gofen & Glossberg Llc bought 25,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 40,283 shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $503,000, up from 15,033 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gofen & Glossberg Llc who had been investing in Ford Motor for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $45.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.59% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $11.51. About 31.01 million shares traded. Ford Motor Company (NYSE:F) has declined 4.43% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.98% the S&P500.
Savant Capital Llc, which manages about $475.42M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Vanguard Index Fds (VTI) by 49,858 shares to 112,187 shares, valued at $15.40 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Marriott Intl Inc New (NASDAQ:MAR) by 2,226 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 254,864 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Tax Managed Intl Fd (VEA).
